verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm documentation names the AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) as a supported target on its PyTorch and JAX install pages, and states that ROCm 7.2.1 supports Radeon 9000 Series (RDNA 4) GPUs on Linux and Windows. It also documents the HIP library stack for porting CUDA-style compute workloads. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of compute workloads running on this card, and an explicit listing of the part in the core HIP SDK compatibility matrix rather than only on framework install pages.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship GPU-compute workloads on the vendor's toolchain — CUDA or ROCm/HIP documentation lists this part as a supported target

citations.quote: ROCm™ 7.2.1 supports the latest Radeon™ 9000 Series (RDNA™ 4) and select 7000 Series (RDNA™ 3) GPUs
AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (gfx1201)AMD Radeon RX 9070 GRE (gfx1201)AMD Radeon RX 9070 (gfx1201)AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT LP (gfx1200)
Libraries prefixed with `hip*` are portable wrappers that implement NVIDIA CUDA-equivalent APIs, allowing CUDA applications to be ported to AMD GPUs with minimal code changes.
